verdict.rationale: Mastra is open-source and self-hostable (Apache 2.0, 'build and host agents anywhere'), which implicitly lets users control where infrastructure and data reside, but there is no explicit region/residency selection feature, data-locality controls, or compliance documentation. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration options, documentation on data storage locations, compliance certifications (e.g., GDPR data residency guarantees).
